sections.label: Regular tree inspections schedule
sections.summary: Trained inspectors carry out regular tree inspections every six to 24 months, depending on location and tree size.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Regular tree inspections are carried out by trained inspectors every six to 24 months, depending on the location and size of the tree.

sections.label: Annual inspections for large trees
sections.summary: Since November 2016, in-depth inspections are also conducted annually for trees of more than four metres in girth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Since November 2016, such in-depth inspections are also conducted annually for trees of more than four metres in girth.

sections.label: Arboriculture courses and tree failures
sections.summary: Courses by international and local experts train NParks staff and others; over 620 arborists are accredited, and tree failure incidents fell from 3,100 in 2000 to 339 in 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: These courses are conducted by both international and local arboriculture experts, for NParks staff, as well as tree care professionals in the private sector and other public agencies that manage trees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There are currently more than 620 arborists in Singapore who are accredited with the International Society of Arboriculture.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: With this comprehensive tree management programme, NParks has reduced the number of tree failure incidents by almost nine-fold, from 3,100 in the year 2000, to 339 in 2020.

sections.label: Tree support systems use
sections.summary: NParks uses tree support systems for trees that have reached maturity or have known structural weaknesses, among others.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: NParks does use tree support systems for trees that have reached maturity or have known structural weaknesses, among others.

sections.label: Support systems constrain young trees
sections.summary: Tree support systems can constrain young and semi-mature trees in the ability to grow.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Tree support systems can constrain, however, young and semi-mature trees in the ability to grow.

sections.label: Trees managed and arborist community
sections.summary: NParks manages some 6 million trees, Town Council areas about a million, and others manage trees; over 620 arborists are trained and accredited.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: NParks manages some 6 million trees in Singapore, whilst in Town Council areas, if I recall right, about a million trees managed in areas under Town Council management.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There are, of course, trees managed by private property owners, by MCSTs, by other agencies as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And so, the first thing is to ensure that the arborists in Singapore, as I said earlier in my reply, that we have a community of arborists numbering more than 620, who are trained and accredited by the International Society of Arboriculture.
